articles.headline: Ukraine reportedly strikes Russian oil refineries in Samara Oblast, Krasnodar Krai
articles.excerpt: Ukraine struck an oil refinery in Samara Oblast and another in southern Russia's Krasnodar Krai overnight on Aug. 8, monitoring channels reported.
